Supreme Court Grants Relief to 'Cockroach Janata Party' Ahead of Protest

The Supreme Court has granted significant relief to the 'Cockroach Janata Party' (CJP) ahead of a planned protest against Gyanesh Kumar. The court dismissed a petition filed against Abhijeet Dipke, who is associated with the CJP, and questioned the petitioner. The specific nature of the protest and the grounds for the petition were not detailed in the provided coverage.
